release_notes: Fixed and refined skill rating WPM calculations.
Straight and iambic WPM display values now use uncapped PARIS WPM while skill evidence remains protected by the target WPM cap.
Both keys WPM and overall skill WPM now use balanced straight and iambic averages instead of being limited only by the slower key source.
Practice speed suggestions now use the best uncapped PARIS median from straight or iambic history, with per-key-source history limits.
Improved database statistics so straight and iambic WPM series use uncapped PARIS WPM values.
Added database regression tests for WPM source calculation, skill rating evidence, uncapped display values and practice speed suggestions.
Various bug fixes and UI responsiveness improvements.
